company.name: Flint
company.shortDescription: Flint is developing the world's first truly sustainable, safe, and non-toxic paper battery platform.
company.description:
Flint is a Singapore-based deep-tech company developing the world's first truly sustainable, safe, and non-toxic paper battery platform.

Flint replaces lithium, cobalt, nickel, PFAS, and other hazardous materials with abundant, low-cost alternatives such as cellulose (the raw material for paper) while delivering competitive performance and a pathway to significantly lower manufacturing costs. Flint's batteries have a 25% to 92% lower carbon footprint and are also safer, i.e. no fires, explosions, leakages, swelling, nor corrosion. The company has already moved beyond R&D, with commercial products in production.

Flint has the potential to become a category-defining platform company in an addressable battery market expected to exceed USD 500 billion by 2030.
